title: Restricted nonlinear shrinkage of high-dimensional residual covariance matrices in multivariate regressions
summary: We study estimation of the p*p residual scatter (shape) matrix in a high-dimensional multivariate linear regression, where p and n grow proportionally. When the coefficient matrix obeys a known linear restriction of rank q < d, as in multivariate analysis of variance, growth-curve models, and reduced-rank regression, the restricted fit leaves additional residual degrees of freedom that sharpen estimation of the shape matrix.
